name: A card accept asked from a session merges only the head the approver saw
description: C-416: request_action card_accept with merge binds the pull request's head when it is asked. The Approvals row shows that head and its diff, the approval merges only it, and a pull request that moved in the meantime fails the request with head_moved and merges nothing.

steps.title: A session asks to accept a card and merge it

steps.caption: A Claude Code session asks to accept C-7 and merge pull request #43.
The request is bound to the head the PR had when it was asked: the approval merges 4f2c9e1 and nothing newer.
View the diff opens exactly that head, so the approver reads what will be merged.
An earlier request was bound to 9a1b3c5. When it was approved, the PR had moved on.

target.text: The head of #43 moved to 4f2c9e1 after the request; nothing was merged — ask again

steps.caption: So it failed with head_moved and the new head; the session reads the same in action_status and asks again.
